Class CachingConfigurerSupport

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.cache.annotation.CachingConfigurerSupport
All Implemented Interfaces:
CachingConfigurer
Direct Known Subclasses:
JCacheConfigurerSupport
@Deprecated(since="6.0") public class CachingConfigurerSupport extends Object implements CachingConfigurer
Deprecated.
自 6.0 版本起，建议直接实现CachingConfigurer。
一个实现了 `CachingConfigurer` 接口的实现，其方法为空，允许子类仅覆盖它们感兴趣的方法。

  • Method Details

    • cacheManager

      public @Nullable CacheManager cacheManager()
      Deprecated.
      描述从接口复制：CachingConfigurer
      Return the cache manager bean to use for annotation-driven cache management. A default CacheResolver will be initialized behind the scenes with this cache manager. For more fine-grained management of the cache resolution, consider setting the CacheResolver directly.

      实现必须显式声明 @Bean，以便缓存管理器参与上下文的生命周期，例如

      @Configuration
@EnableCaching
class AppConfig implements CachingConfigurer {
    @Bean // important!
    @Override
    CacheManager cacheManager() {
        // configure and return CacheManager instance
    }
    // ...
}
      See @EnableCaching for more complete examples.
      Specified by:
      `cacheManager` 接口 `CachingConfigurer` 中

    • cacheResolver

      public @Nullable CacheResolver cacheResolver()
      Deprecated.
      描述从接口复制：CachingConfigurer
      Return the CacheResolver bean to use to resolve regular caches for annotation-driven cache management. This is an alternative and more powerful option of specifying the CacheManager to use.

      如果同时设置了 `CachingConfigurer.cacheManager()` 和 `cacheResolver()`，则缓存管理器将被忽略。

      实现必须显式声明 @Bean，以便缓存解析器参与上下文的生命周期，例如

      @Configuration
@EnableCaching
class AppConfig implements CachingConfigurer {
    @Bean // important!
    @Override
    CacheResolver cacheResolver() {
        // configure and return CacheResolver instance
    }
    // ...
}
      See EnableCaching for more complete examples.
      Specified by:
      `cacheResolver` 接口 `CachingConfigurer` 中

      public @Nullable KeyGenerator keyGenerator()
      Deprecated.
      描述从接口复制：CachingConfigurer
      Return the key generator bean to use for annotation-driven cache management.

      默认情况下，使用SimpleKeyGenerator。有关更完整的示例，请查看@EnableCaching。

      Specified by:

    • errorHandler

      public @Nullable CacheErrorHandler errorHandler()
      Deprecated.
      描述从接口复制：CachingConfigurer
      Return the CacheErrorHandler to use to handle cache-related errors.

      默认情况下，使用SimpleCacheErrorHandler，它将异常抛回给客户端。有关更完整的示例，请参阅@EnableCaching。

      Specified by:
